The most likely truth is that the ticks are raw FLOP (10^14-10^17 left, 10^8-10^12 right), but this cannot be confirmed from the rendered page, and a reader who misreads them will conclude the figure is off by fifteen orders of magnitude.
evidence: Left panel geometry is unit-invariant (the curves occupy identical relative positions under either reading), so the tick glyphs are the only discriminator and they are sub-legible at the rendered resolution. Right panel: 2N = 2*70e9 = 1.4e11 FLOP/token; under a 10^8-10^12 axis this sits at ~79% of panel height, under a 10^-1-10^-5 (PFLOP) axis at ~98%; the rendered flat line sits at roughly 80% of panel height, which favours the raw-FLOP reading, but this is an estimate from a low-resolution render, not a measurement. If they read 10^-1..10^2 and 10^-1..10^-5, the axis titles must be changed to PFLOP (or the data rescaled) - this would be a P0.
